definitions.gloss: lip service, mere words, empty talk
definitions.explanation: Words that are not backed by genuine feeling or action. Implies insincerity or superficiality.

definitions.gloss: tip of the tongue, way of speaking
definitions.explanation: The literal tip of the lips/tongue, or one's manner of speaking.

notes:
{口先|くちさき} literally means "tip of the mouth/lips" and is used almost exclusively with negative connotations — implying insincerity, empty words, or manipulation.

SENSE 1 — LIP SERVICE:
- {口先|くちさき}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{約束|やくそく}→約束：01517_yakusoku⟧: a promise that's just empty words
- {口先|くちさき}⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{行動|こうどう}→行動：02728_koudou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{伴|ともな}わない→伴う：10389_tomonau⟧: all talk and no action
- {口先|くちさき}⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{謝罪|しゃざい}→謝罪：06754_shazai⟧: an insincere apology

SENSE 2 — SMOOTH TALK:
- {口先|くちさき}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦うまい→うまい：01279_umai⟧: smooth-talking, glib
- {口先|くちさき}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧だます: to deceive people with words
- {口先|くちさき}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{器用|きよう}→器用：02655_kiyou⟧さ: verbal dexterity (negative nuance)
